verses.sanskrit:
सौतिरुवाच।
              एवमुक्त्वा ततः श्रीमान्मन्त्रिभिश्चानुमोदितः। आरुरोह प्रतिज्ञां स सर्पसत्राय पार्थिवः॥१॥
verses.english: Sauti said : The illustrious king having said so, the ministers expressed their approbation. The king expressed his determination of performing a Snake-sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मन्भरतशार्दूलो राजा पारिक्षितस्तदा। पुरोहितमथाहूय ऋत्विजो वसुधाधिपः॥२॥
verses.english: The Lord of the earth, the best of the Kurus, king (Janamejaya) the son of Parikshit, then called his priest and Ritvijas.
verses.bhavadeepa: एकपञ्चाशत्तमः अध्यायः  *दुर्धरमित्यादिः सार्धः श्लोकः क्षिप्तः इति भाति। उवाच अब्रवीदिति पौनरुक्त्यात्। केषुचित्पुस्तकेष्वदर्शनाच्च।  एवमुक्त्वेति॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: अब्रवीद्वाक्यसंपन्नः कार्यसंपत्करं वचः। यो मे हिंसितवांस्तातं तक्षकः स दुरात्मवान्॥३॥
verses.english: And that accomplished speaker spoke on the accomplishment of his great task. (He said), “I must avenge on that wretch Takshaka.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिकुर्यां यथा तस्य तद्भवन्तो ब्रुवन्तु मे। अपि तत्कर्म विदितं भवतां येन पन्नगम्॥४॥
verses.english: Tell me what I must do. Do you know any act by which I can throw Takshaka with all his friends and relatives in the blazing fire? I want to burn the wretch of a snake as he burnt my father with his poison.

verses.sanskrit: तक्षकं संप्रदीप्तेऽग्नौ प्रक्षिपेयं सबान्धवम्। यथा तेन पिता मह्यं पूर्वं दग्धो विषाग्निना। तथाऽहमपि तं पापं दग्धुमिच्छामि पन्नगम्॥५॥

ऋत्विज ऊचुः।
              अस्ति राजन्महत्सत्रं त्वदर्थं देवनिर्मितम्। सर्वसत्रमितिख्यातं पुराणे परिपठ्यते॥६॥
verses.english: The Ritwijas said : O king, there is a sacrifice advised by the celestials for you. It is known as the Snakesacrifice and is spoken of in the Puranas.

verses.sanskrit: आहर्ता तस्य सत्रस्य त्वन्नान्योऽस्ति नराधिप। इति पौराणिकाः प्राहुरस्माकं चास्ति स क्रतुः॥७॥
verses.english: O king, you alone can accomplish it and no one else. The men, learned in the Puranas, have told us that there is such a sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तः स राजर्षिर्मेने दग्धं हि तक्षकम्। हुताशनमुखे दीप्ते प्रविष्टमिति सत्तम॥८॥
verses.english: Sauti said : O excellent one, thus addressed, that royal sage thought Takshaka already thrown into the blazing fire and burnt to ashes.
verses.bhavadeepa: मह्यं मम।। ५॥  त्वन्नान्यः त्वमेव नान्यं यद्वा त्वत् त्वत्तो नान्योऽस्ति  ॥७॥

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽब्रवीन्मन्त्रविदस्तान्राजा ब्राह्मणांस्तदा। आहरिष्यामि तत्सत्रं संभाराः संभ्रियन्तु मे॥९॥
verses.english: The king then told these Brahmanas, learned in Mantras, “I shall perform that sacrifice. Tell me the things that are necessary.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते ऋत्विजस्तस्य शास्त्रतो द्विजसत्तम। तं देशं मापयामासुर्यज्ञायतनकारणात्॥१०॥
verses.english: O best of Biahmanas, thereupon his wise Ritwijas, learned in the Shastras, measured, according to the ordinances, a piece of land for the sacrificial platform.

verses.sanskrit: यथावद्वेदविद्वांसः सर्वे बुद्धेः परंगताः। ऋद्ध्या परमया युक्तमिष्टं द्विजगणैर्युतम्॥११॥
verses.english: It was graced by the presence of holy Brahmanas; it was decked with much valuable wealth; it was full of wealth and paddy. On this sacrificial platform they according to rites installed the king in the Snake-sacrifice. But before the commencement of the sacrifice happened.

verses.sanskrit: राजानं दीक्षयामासुः सर्पसत्राप्तये तदा। इदं चासीत्तत्र पूर्वं सर्पसत्रे भविष्यति॥१३॥
निमित्तं महदुत्पन्नं यज्ञविघ्नकरं तदा। यज्ञस्यायतने तस्मिन्क्रियमाणे वचोऽब्रवीत्॥१४॥
verses.english: An incident which foreboded a hindrance to it. For when the sacrificial platform was being built, a man, Suta by caste, well acquainted with the Puranas and learned in the art of masonry and of laying foundations, said,
verses.bhavadeepa: दीक्षयामासुः दीक्षां ग्राहितवन्तः । सर्पसत्राप्तये सर्पसत्रफलाप्तये भविष्यति भाविनि  ॥१३॥

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन्देशे च काले च मापनेयं प्रवर्तिता। ब्राह्मणं कारणं कृत्वा नायं संस्थास्यते क्रतुः॥१६॥
verses.english: “The land in which the platform was made and the time when it was measured indicate that this sacrifice will not be completed. A Brahmana will be its cause."
verses.bhavadeepa: इति वक्ष्यमाणं यास्मिन्देशे इत्यादि सूतो जात्या पौराणिकः शिल्पागमवेत्ता॥१५॥

verses.sanskrit: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु राजाऽसौ प्राग्दीक्षाकालमब्रवीत्। क्षत्तारं न हि मे कश्चिदज्ञातः प्रविशेदिति॥१७॥
verses.english: Having heard this, the king, before he was installed in the sacrifice, ordered the gate keepers, saying, “None must be allowed to enter here without my permission."
